support.title: How can we help?
support.subtitle: Find answers about orders, shipping and our policies — all in one place.
support.faq1a: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express delivery arrives within 1-2 business days in most metro areas.
support.faq2a: Yes! Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking link you can follow in real time.
support.faq3q: What payment methods do you accept?
support.faq3a: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
support.faq4q: How do I return an item?
support.faq4a: Start a return from your account within 30 days of delivery. We'll send you a prepaid label — returns are free.
support.faq5a: Currently we ship to over 40 countries. Available destinations appear at checkout.
support.faq6a: Absolutely. All payments are processed over encrypted connections and we never store card details.
support.shippingBody1: We offer free standard shipping on all orders over $50. Orders below that threshold ship for a flat $4.99 fee.
support.shippingBody2: Not happy with your purchase? Return any item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be unused and in original packaging. Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5-7 business days after we receive the return.
support.termsIntro: By using NovaMart you agree to the following terms:
support.termsItem1: Products are sold subject to availability; prices may change without notice.
support.termsItem2: Accounts must provide accurate and current information.
support.termsItem3: Abusive behaviour towards staff or other customers may result in account suspension.
support.termsItem4: All website content, including imagery and copy, is the property of NovaMart.
support.privacyBody1: We collect only the information necessary to process your orders: name, contact details and shipping address.
support.privacyBody2: We never sell your personal data. Analytics are anonymised and used solely to improve the shopping experience. You may request deletion of your data at any time by contacting support.
